main_body: stone tower building with conical green roof
top_band: green tiled conical roof slope from rows 4 to 39
evidence: The structure has a visible sloped roof surface (rows 4-39) sitting above a vertical stone wall face (rows 40-94), with a dark eave shadow at rows 40-41 and recessed window/door frames.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference buildings, the stone bricks are large uniform rectangles filled with flat grey tones lacking speckle or per-stone irregular shading, the roof tiles are simple 2-color checkerboard bands without per-tile highlights, and the door/window lack detailed grain.
